time_to_data.note: Time is counted to the date the data was sent. Recent years have fewer projects with data because some have not been sent it yet.

repeat_requests.definition: A project 'returned' if more data was sent to it more than 7 days after its first.

basket_turnaround.note: Basket requests are tracked in Planner, which started in 2022, so these figures only cover requests from 31 Jan 2022 onwards.

basket_stats.note: Every basket counts once, in the year its data was sent in Jay, from 2021, and only for projects that are counted in the metrics.

bundles.note: lift above 1 means the pair is requested together more often than chance would suggest.
